pages.text: The terminal does not make the frontier safe. It remembers an address.
pages.title: The threshold
An address in the dark
pages.text: Use it to select an expedition, difficulty and route length. Read the mission's requirements before deploying. Some need a sigil, previous expedition proof, tokens, or a more established campaign.

pages.title: An address in the dark
pages.text: Starting resolves a safe route first. If none can be found, nothing is deployed.

pages.title: Before you step through
pages.text: The portal opens above the terminal. Enter it to deploy and receive a compass. Other players may join through it until the first checkpoint seals the party.

pages.title: Before you step through
pages.text: Take food, a weapon and room for recovered cargo. The terminal can offer loaded modded dimensions too; their own biome creatures may answer a checkpoint's call.

pages.title: Before you step through
pages.text: An absent dimension cannot host a route.
Place it facing a safe space. Its portal opens above it.
